_about: STUB (ship rows to move into the shared file)

classes.label: Battle carrier
classes.blurb: Two battleship turrets forward and a flight deck aft. She stands in a gun line and still flies a strike of her own, with half a carrier's wing.

classes.label: Super battleship
classes.blurb: Four triple turrets of the heaviest guns afloat. The strongest gun ship in any sea, and the slowest and dearest to build.

classes.label: Raider cruiser
classes.blurb: A long-legged, fast cruiser built to hunt merchant ships far out on the trade routes and to outrun whatever she cannot fight.

classes.label: Anti-air cruiser
classes.blurb: Six twin dual-purpose mounts and radar to aim them. She blunts every air strike on the fleet she sails with.

classes.label: Scout submarine
classes.blurb: A big ocean boat with a seaplane in a hangar. Her aircraft searches the seas beyond her own, and she raids like any submarine.

classes.label: Escort carrier
classes.blurb: A small carrier on a merchant hull, quick and cheap, and built in a small yard. A third of a wing, enough to cover a convoy.
